scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Yoyo Tails from 'Yoyo's', Acorn from 'Coco's' and Raccoon Leaf from 'Smokies'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
溜溜猴尾巴可以從溜溜猴身上獲得，橡果可以從可可身上獲得，變身葉子可以從狸貓身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can find them easily around fields, but the field east of Ayothaya is the best spot for hunting all 3 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
野外到處都有這些魔物，不過哎喲泰雅東邊的野外最適合一次狩獵這三種。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get to Ayothaya, you better go to 'Aibakthing' in Alberta and pay his fare.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
要去哎喲泰雅，可以到艾爾貝塔找艾巴克辛並支付船費。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
咦？你確定嗎？好像哪裡不對勁...

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
真奇怪。
請按“Alt + U”檢查任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Wow~ you did an excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
哇~幹得真漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
非常感謝。願上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:

Ha~! Ha~!
I will give you a reward as promised.
scripts.translation:

哈~！哈~！
我會按承諾給你獎勵。

scripts.translation:

不過，烤餅乾和蛋糕呢？

scripts.text:

You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Well-baked Cookies' and '1 Piece of Cake' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:

你還沒做任務呢。為什麼又回到這裡？
你需要帶5個薑餅和1個小蛋糕來完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Well-baked Cookie from 'Cookies' who wears red or green shirts.
For getting Piece of Cake, you should look for 'Mystcases'.
scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
穿紅衣或綠衣的綠餅人會掉落烤餅乾。
蛋糕則可以從神秘箱身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]

scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
這兩種魔物都在玩具工廠倉庫或玩具監控室。去艾爾帕蘭東北邊找克勞斯先生問路吧。

[Dashia]

scripts.translation:

土撥鼠會掉落這些物品。
妙勒尼爾死亡之坑裡就有土撥鼠，不過二樓很危險，要小心！

[Dashia]

scripts.translation:
[達西亞]
去吉芬找卡普拉職員，他們可以把你傳送過去。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
